newsitem.title: USA: O'Sullivan Q2 net boosted by lower costs.
newsitem.headline: O'Sullivan Q2 net boosted by lower costs.

text.p: O'Sullivan Industries Holdings Inc, which makes ready-to-assemble furniture, said Thursday its fiscal 1997 second quarter earnings benefited from higher gross margins and lower operating expenses.
The growing acceptance of a number of our new products increased our average selling price," said Daniel O'Sullivan, in a statement.
In addition, lower raw material costs and higher capacity utilization at all three of its plants boosted results, it said.
Earlier Thursday, the company reported earnings for its fiscal 1997 second quarter ended December 31, 1996 rose to $4.6 million or $0.27 a share from $458,000 or $O.03 in the same period a year ago.

Net sales increased to $80.6 million from $79.6 million in the fiscal 1996 second quarter. Sales for the second quarter were only slightly ahead of last year's level due to the bankruptcy of a major customer that accounted for about $7.5 million in net sales for the second quarter a year ago.
Shares of O'Sullivan were trading unchanged at 13-7/8.
